read: Adoption of the same fixed wrong answer under different text cue types: baseline 0.0667, moved to the front (primacy) 0.0833, framed as ruling out the holdout's own pick (negation) 0.1417, padded with an exclusion qualifier 0.0333. Deviations from baseline isolate pure position/order sensitivity (primacy), the extra push from explicitly cancelling the holdout's prior (negation), and whether pseudo-justification padding adds anything (qualifier). Paired McNemars test each cue against the baseline assertion.
